titulo: Quiz — Allergy and the invisible ingredient
subtitulo: One lunch in Seville: a nut allergy, a vegetarian, a plate of green beans and a shared fryer
introPt: Quiz time. You sit down for lunch in Seville. You're allergic to nuts, you're vegetarian, and the waitress is friendly, busy, and completely convinced that a little bit of ham never hurt anybody. Listen as many times as you like, then answer the questions.
cenario: Lunch in a Seville taberna: declare an allergy, escalate it when it isn't taken seriously, find out what's actually in the green beans and the vegetable rice, and check the fryer before ordering chips.

dialogo.pinyin: OH-lah, BWEH-nahs · keh bahn ah toh-MAR
dialogo.pt: — Hello. What are you having? (the waitress)

dialogo.es: Antes de nada: soy alérgico a los frutos secos.
dialogo.pinyin: AHN-tehs deh NAH-dhah · soy ah-LEHR-khee-koh ah lohs FROO-tohs SEH-kohs
dialogo.pt: — Before anything else: I'm allergic to nuts.

dialogo.es: Ah, vale. Un poquito no pasa nada, ¿no?
dialogo.pinyin: ah, BAH-leh · oon poh-KEE-toh noh PAH-sah NAH-dhah, noh
dialogo.pt: — Ah, right. A tiny bit's fine though, isn't it?

dialogo.es: No. Es alergia, no es manía. Es una alergia grave. Puedo acabar en el hospital.
dialogo.pinyin: noh · es ah-LEHR-khyah, noh es mah-NEE-ah · es OO-nah ah-LEHR-khyah GRAH-beh · PWEH-dhoh ah-kah-BAR en el ohs-pee-TAL
dialogo.pt: — No. It's an allergy, not a fad. It's serious. I could end up in hospital.

dialogo.es: Perdone. Ahora mismo aviso en cocina y le traigo la carta de alérgenos.
dialogo.pinyin: pehr-DOH-neh · ah-OH-rah MEES-moh ah-BEE-soh en koh-THEE-nah ee leh TRAI-goh lah KAR-tah deh ah-LEHR-kheh-nohs
dialogo.pt: — I'm sorry. I'll tell the kitchen right now and bring you the allergen list.

dialogo.es: Las judías verdes están muy buenas hoy.
dialogo.pinyin: lahs khoo-DEE-ahs BEHR-dehs ehs-TAN mwee BWEH-nahs oy
dialogo.pt: — The green beans are very good today.
— Does it have ham or chorizo in it?

dialogo.es: Sí, lleva jamón. Va picadito, casi no se ve.
dialogo.pinyin: see, YEH-bah khah-MOHN · bah pee-kah-DEE-toh, KAH-see noh seh beh
dialogo.pt: — Yes, it's got ham. Finely chopped, you can hardly see it.

dialogo.es: Soy vegetariano: no como carne ni pescado. ¿Me lo puede hacer sin jamón?
dialogo.pinyin: soy beh-kheh-tah-RYAH-noh · noh KOH-moh KAR-neh nee pehs-KAH-dhoh · meh loh PWEH-dheh ah-THEHR seen khah-MOHN
dialogo.pt: — I'm vegetarian: I don't eat meat or fish. Could you make it without the ham?

dialogo.es: Claro. ¿Y el arroz de verduras? Ese lleva caldo de pescado.
dialogo.pinyin: KLAH-roh · ee el ah-RROTH deh behr-DOO-rahs · EH-seh YEH-bah KAL-doh deh pehs-KAH-dhoh
dialogo.pt: — Of course. And the vegetable rice? That one's made with fish stock.

dialogo.es: Entonces las patatas fritas. ¿Lo fríen en la misma freidora que el pescado?
dialogo.pinyin: en-TOHN-thehs lahs pah-TAH-tahs FREE-tahs · loh FREE-en en lah MEES-mah fray-DOH-rah keh el pehs-KAH-dhoh
dialogo.pt: — The chips then. Do you fry them in the same fryer as the fish?

dialogo.es: Sí, es la misma. Pero le hago una ensalada y unas judías sin jamón, ¿vale?
dialogo.pinyin: see, es lah MEES-mah · PEH-roh leh AH-goh OO-nah en-sah-LAH-dhah ee OO-nahs khoo-DEE-ahs seen khah-MOHN, BAH-leh
dialogo.pt: — Yes, it's the same one. But I'll do you a salad and some beans without ham, all right?

perguntas.pergunta: The waitress says «un poquito no pasa nada». What is she suggesting?
perguntas.es: The waitress says «un poquito no pasa nada». What is she suggesting?
opcoes: That the dish is very small
That a tiny bit of the allergen won't do any harm
That there is no charge for it
perguntas.explica: This is the exact moment the ladder exists for. She isn't being careless — she has filed your allergy under 'preference'. The answer is the hammer: «Es alergia, no es manía.»
perguntas.pt: This is the exact moment the ladder exists for. She isn't being careless — she has filed your allergy under 'preference'. The answer is the hammer: «Es alergia, no es manía.»

perguntas.pergunta: Which sentence finally changes her behaviour?
perguntas.es: Which sentence finally changes her behaviour?
opcoes: «Es alergia, no es manía. Es una alergia grave.»
perguntas.explica: Naming the thing you're being suspected of — manía, a fussy little rule — kills it, and «grave» makes it medical. Straight after that she goes to the kitchen and fetches the allergen list.
perguntas.pt: Naming the thing you're being suspected of — manía, a fussy little rule — kills it, and «grave» makes it medical. Straight after that she goes to the kitchen and fetches the allergen list.

perguntas.pergunta: What is actually in the «judías verdes» — the green beans?
perguntas.es: What is actually in the «judías verdes» — the green beans?
opcoes: Nothing but beans and olive oil
perguntas.explica: The Spanish invisible ingredient. Ham is used as seasoning, not as a meat course — which is why «is it vegetarian?» gets you nowhere and «¿Lleva jamón o chorizo?» gets you the truth.
perguntas.pt: The Spanish invisible ingredient. Ham is used as seasoning, not as a meat course — which is why «is it vegetarian?» gets you nowhere and «¿Lleva jamón o chorizo?» gets you the truth.

perguntas.pergunta: Why is «ni pescado» added to «no como carne»?
perguntas.es: Why is «ni pescado» added to «no como carne»?
opcoes: Because in Spain fish is often not counted as «carne», so «no como carne» alone gets you tuna
To ask for a bigger portion
perguntas.explica: «Carne» in everyday Spanish means meat from land animals. Drop the «ni pescado» and the anchovies arrive with a clear conscience. Say it every single time.
perguntas.pt: «Carne» in everyday Spanish means meat from land animals. Drop the «ni pescado» and the anchovies arrive with a clear conscience. Say it every single time.

perguntas.pergunta: What is wrong with the «arroz de verduras» — the vegetable rice?
perguntas.es: What is wrong with the «arroz de verduras» — the vegetable rice?
opcoes: It's only served in the evening
It costs extra at the table
perguntas.explica: «De verduras» describes what you can see, not what it was built on. «¿Lleva caldo de pescado o de carne?» is the question that catches it — and paella is the classic offender.
perguntas.pt: «De verduras» describes what you can see, not what it was built on. «¿Lleva caldo de pescado o de carne?» is the question that catches it — and paella is the classic offender.

perguntas.pergunta: Why does he ask about the «freidora» before ordering chips?
perguntas.es: Why does he ask about the «freidora» before ordering chips?
opcoes: To check whether they're frozen or fresh
Because a Spanish bar usually has one fryer, so the chips share the oil with the fish
Because fried food is charged separately
perguntas.explica: Cross-contamination is about equipment, not ingredients — and this is the question no phrasebook gives you. One fryer does the croquetas, the calamari, the fish and your 'safe' chips.
perguntas.pt: Cross-contamination is about equipment, not ingredients — and this is the question no phrasebook gives you. One fryer does the croquetas, the calamari, the fish and your 'safe' chips.

perguntas.pergunta: You've explained twice and you still aren't confident. What do you reach for?
perguntas.es: You've explained twice and you still aren't confident. What do you reach for?
perguntas.explica: Every place serving food in Spain is legally required to have allergen information for every dish. Asking for it stops the conversation being about your accent and makes it about a document they must produce.
